funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Pre-Doctoral Research Bursary 10/26

amount.raw: salary and/or research expenses up to a maximum of £50,000.00

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised Specialist Trainee 1-5 post in Histopathology.
opportunities.summary: Funds short projects (3, 6, 9 or 12 months) for early career clinical academic research trainee pathologists to promote research in pathology.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical PhD Fellowship 10/26

amount.raw: 3 years of PhD funding covering trainee's salary, university fees and consumables budget of £20,000 per year for 3 years

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised Specialist Trainee 1-6 post in Histopathology or other tissue specialty within pathology.
opportunities.summary: Provides 3 years of PhD funding for medically qualified trainees in Histopathology or other tissue specialities within Pathology to increase research skills in tissue-based research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical Lecturer Grant 10/26

amount.raw: up to £220,000 over a maximum of 4 years, covering 50% of salary costs plus up to £20K consumables per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised Specialist Trainee in Histopathology or Dental/Oral Pathology (post FRCPath part 1 or within 6 months). Applicants should have been a member for at least 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Offers histopathology trainees post PhD/MD the opportunity to continue research part-time whilst completing clinical training, similar to NIHR Clinical Lectureships.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Clinical Lecturer Support Grant 10/26

amount.raw: £60,000 per annum funding over a 2 year period, to fund the costs of employing a research technician or assistant and associated consumables

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society for at least 2 years who have completed a PhD or MD (usually within the preceding 5 years) and are in a recognised Specialist Trainee (normally ST3 and above) histopathology programme accredited for CCT in Great Britain & Ireland.
opportunities.summary: Supports continuing research projects over a 2 year period by academic trainee histopathologists following award of a PhD or MD, progressing through final stages of histopathology training.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Intermediate Research Fellowship 10/26

amount.raw: up to £120,000 over a maximum of 2 years, covering 50% of salary costs plus up to £20K consumables per year

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Applicants must have a PhD/MD and have completed clinical training at the time of taking up the award in either Histopathology or Dental/Oral Pathology. Applicants should have been a member of the Society for at least 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Supports newly accredited pathologists during the period between completing training and obtaining full funding for a Clinician Scientist post.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: PhD Studentship (Non-Clinical) 10/26

amount.raw: Support for a four year PhD including stipend, research & training allowance, conference allowance and consumables of up to £15,000 per annum, set at MRC rates

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain and/or Ireland in good standing for at least 12 months who wish to act as supervisors of a project leading to a PhD. Priority to early career researchers in pathology.
opportunities.summary: Supports a four-year PhD in pathology, with funding set at MRC rates.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Hodgkin Early Career Pathology Researcher Grant 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £1000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain or Ireland in a Foundation year 1 or 2 post or a Trainee 1-3 post in Histopathology.
opportunities.summary: Encourages early career pathology researchers, in particular trainees in the first few years of their careers, to undertake investigative research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Leishman Early Career Pathology Researcher Grant 10/26

amount.raw: Up to £2000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain or Ireland in a Foundation year 1 or 2 post or a Trainee 1-3 post in Histopathology.
opportunities.summary: Encourages early career pathology researchers, in particular trainees in the first few years of their careers, to undertake investigative research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Cuthbert Dukes Grant Scheme 2027

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £20,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainee members of the Society for at least 12 months, based in Great Britain or Ireland, in a recognised specialist trainee 2-6 post in histopathology or dental/oral pathology.
opportunities.summary: Encourages early to mid career pathology researchers (academic trainees in histopathology) to undertake investigative tissue-based research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Trainee Small Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Trainees (specialist registrars or honorary specialist registrars), consultants & post-doctoral histopathology trainees who are members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Encourages investigative research in histopathology, particularly aimed at generating research data which may contribute towards a substantive application to a funding body.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Post-Doctoral Collaborative Small Grant 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: The academic histopathologist applicant must be a member of the Pathological Society in good standing for at least 12 months. The post-doctoral scientist applicant must be a member, hold a PhD and be employed at scientific grade 6-9.
opportunities.summary: Cements a new or developing collaborative partnership between medical trainees and science-based trainees.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Visiting Fellowship 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Medical and allied professions working in pathologically-related bio-medical research. Applications accepted from non-members and members of the Society based in Great Britain & Ireland.
opportunities.summary: Supports travel to other institutions to learn new techniques of value in research, with preference for molecular & cell biology techniques.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Consultant's Pump Priming Small Grant 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society in good standing for 12 months. Aimed at consultants (or Honorary Consultants) in Histopathology or senior scientific non-clinical researchers (of at least Senior Lecturer level).
opportunities.summary: Encourages consultants in Histopathology or senior scientific non-clinical researchers to undertake investigative research in histopathology.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Equipment Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000 per application

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society based in Great Britain & Ireland in good standing for at least 12 months. Non-members may apply as co-applicants with a member.
opportunities.summary: Supports part purchase of items of equipment and/or software for pathologists actively engaged in research.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: International Collaborative Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £15,000 per application

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society from Great Britain and/or Ireland in good standing for at least 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Develops and/or strengthens collaboration in scholarly pathological activities between pathology institutions in Great Britain & Ireland and international institutions.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Open Scheme 09/26

amount.raw: Support for activities not covered by another Society scheme (amount not specified)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society in good standing for at least 12 months. Non-members may also apply with the support of a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Supports activities not covered by another Society scheme, all of which should support the Society's mission.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Public Engagement Scheme 09/26

amount.raw: A maximum sum of £3,000 per application

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society in good standing for at least 12 months. Non-members may also apply with the support of a Society member.
opportunities.summary: Supports activities related to the promotion of public awareness and understanding of pathology.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Education Grant Scheme 10/26

amount.raw: The sum requested should not exceed £5,000

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Members of the Society who have been in membership for a minimum of 12 months.
opportunities.summary: Funds a range of activities in the performance, development and assessment of undergraduate & postgraduate education in pathology.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Intercalated Degree 11/26

amount.raw: Covers university fees of up to £9,000, stipend £5,000 and consumables £1,800

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Medical, dental or veterinary undergraduates who are members of the Society based in UK &/or Ireland.
opportunities.summary: Annual sum to support intercalating degree students (either BSc or MRes/MSc).

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Student Society Bursary Scheme

amount.raw: The sum requested should not exceed £500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Established student societies where the applicant is a member of the Society based in UK &/or Ireland.
opportunities.summary: Supports the promotion of the understanding of pathology amongst medical, dental and biomedical students.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: 2026 Undergraduate Essay Competition

amount.raw: Prize: £500

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate members of the Society.
opportunities.summary: Essay competition on the topic 'How can personalised pathology facilitate personalised medicine?', with the winning essay published on the Society website and presented at the Winter Meeting.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: JSPS Summer Studentships 2026

amount.raw: Up to £250 per week, with a maximum of £1,250 per student (equivalent to a 5 week placement)

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Research-active, medically qualified, Consultant Pathologists or Clinical Lecturers (or local equivalent), who are members of the Pathological Society and in a substantive or honorary post at a University or Research Institute.
opportunities.summary: Joint bursary with Jean Shanks Foundation to support Year 1 and Year 2 medical and dental students to carry out a research project in pathology during vacation periods.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Winter Pathological Society Travel Bursary for Concessionary (with RSM) 2027

amount.raw: The total award is up to £500. An additional amount of up to £125 is available for child care fees.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Post-graduate students (PhD, MD or MSc) or Pathology Trainees who are members of the Society. Members awarded a PathSoc travel bursary within the last 6 months are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Covers costs to attend a Winter Path Society meeting, contributing towards travel, accommodation and registration fees.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Winter Pathological Society Travel Bursary for Undergraduates/FD (with RSM) 2027

amount.raw: Costs of up to £350 to attend a Winter Pathological Society meeting

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Undergraduate and Foundation Doctor members of the Society. Members awarded a PathSoc travel bursary within the last 6 months are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Covers costs to attend a Winter Pathological Society meeting, contributing towards travel, accommodation and registration fees.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Travel & Conference Bursary 2026 (external events)

amount.raw: The Travel & Conference bursary is up to £500.00 and must supplement monies from other sources.

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Concessionary members of the Society in good standing for 12 months and Undergraduate/Foundation Doctor members of the Society. Members awarded a PathSoc travel bursary within the last 6 months are ineligible.
opportunities.summary: Covers the costs of travel and/or registration fees to promote scientific communications at major international meetings (external events only).

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: CRUK / Path Soc Predoctoral Research Bursary

deadlines.raw: March and September of each year

amount.raw: Funding support for up to £50,000 to cover salary and/or research expenses over a period of up to 12 months

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Clinicians wanting to get involved in cancer research projects early in their careers (any area of CRUK's funding remit except clinical trials and drug development).
opportunities.summary: Joint Cancer Research UK and Pathological Society bursary providing short term funding to allow clinicians to get involved in cancer research projects early in their careers.

opportunities.funder: The Pathological Society of Great Britain and Ireland
opportunities.title: Journal of Pathology Publication Grant Scheme

amount.raw: Society pays the article processing charge for accepted papers

opportunities.eligibility_summary: Corresponding Authors who are Society Members in good standing (for a minimum of 12 months) whose papers have been accepted for publication in the Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research.
opportunities.summary: Grant scheme marking the establishment of The Journal of Pathology: Clinical Research, covering the article processing charge for accepted papers.
